main_body: tall dark stone throne with backrest, red cushioned seat, gold-capped armrests, and stepped base
top_band: red cushioned seat top surface on rows 18-21 (dark to light red gradient towards the front) with a 1px gold front edge at row 22
evidence: Looking down the centre column: rows 0-17 form the upright backrest; rows 18-21 (4 rows) show the horizontal red seat surface seen from above, bounded at row 22 by a distinct 1px light gold front edge line, followed by a dark shadowed front face and stepped plinth on rows 23-31 (9 rows).

style.evidence: Compared to the rich stone coursework on the reference well and wood grain on the stall, the throne relies on flat horizontal bands (solid red rows on the seat, solid grey and yellow bars on the step) and near-black vertical columns with no stone grain or per-block shading.
